outcome: postoperative pain scores (VAS scores at rest and during movement)
analgesic requirements (first PCEA dose time, number of PCEA doses required per hour, total analgesic consumed)
cohort: Eighty-one pregnant women, aged 18-45 years, who underwent cesarean sections with combined spinal epidural anesthesia and received patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA).
finding: The 20 mL epidural initiation volume resulted in a lower analgesic dose requirement during the early postoperative period and delayed the requirement for analgesia compared to 5 mL and 10 mL volumes.
followup_time: Acute postoperative period, with specific measurements taken during the first 2 hours after epidural study drug administration.
